goldStandardBlock: GOLD-STANDARD CRAFT BAR (the operator's explicit benchmark: every AI board must hit the CRAFT LEVEL of the finalized Rainbow-Animated template — every key element a DESIGNED OBJECT with silhouette, volume, character, and tasteful motion — adapted to the brand's mood. The bar is the CRAFT, not the rainbow style. Obey alongside, never above, TYPOGRAPHY-IS-PRIORITY-ONE and the NO-REDACTION-BARS law.):

OBJECTHOOD IS THE BAR. Every KEY element — the hero/wordmark, each featured number/stat/price, a clock, a countdown, the announcement, a badge, a divider — must read as a DESIGNED OBJECT with its own silhouette, volume, and depth, NEVER a plain rounded-corner rectangle with a drop shadow (that flat dark-field-with-accent-text look is the exact 'lifeless' failure we are killing). Before output, name the SHAPE of each major element ('this is a medallion', 'this is a starburst', 'this is a ribbon'); if the honest answer is 'a rounded rectangle', redesign it into a real object.

PICK ONE SIGNATURE SHAPE MOTIF from the brand metaphor and render the hero + 1-2 feature elements AS that shape, recurring 2-3x — recurrence is what separates a designed piece from a template (the gold standard echoes one 'sunny disc' across clock, logo ring, and sun). Examples by metaphor: cafe = coffee-ring disc + torn-paper band; steakhouse = wax-seal medallion + branded-iron bar; law firm = engraved double-rule seal + serif monogram disc; gym/sports = chevron blade-slash + hex plate; school/fair = starburst badge + notched ribbon + cloud.

BUILD BADGES / SEALS / STARBURSTS WITH clip-path:polygon(...) — NOT border-radius — and seat a WHOLE content group (number + unit + label) INSIDE the shape as flow children, so the silhouette IS the framing and the text needs NO box behind it. The gold-standard 12-point starburst (recolor to brand): clip-path:polygon(50% 0%,60% 12%,75% 8%,73% 23%,88% 25%,80% 38%,96% 45%,84% 55%,96% 65%,80% 70%,88% 82%,73% 80%,75% 96%,60% 88%,50% 100%,40% 88%,25% 96%,27% 80%,12% 82%,20% 70%,4% 65%,16% 55%,4% 45%,20% 38%,12% 25%,27% 23%,25% 8%,40% 12%). Ribbon/banner = a notched/zigzag polygon or a flag-tail polygon(0 0,100% 0,100% 70%,50% 100%,0 70%). Kids = a 12/28-point star; premium = a 6-sided faceted gem or a chevron-cornered seal.

GIVE FEATURE OBJECTS REAL VOLUME: a directional radial-gradient highlight (light source TOP-LEFT, always offset — circle at 35% 30%, never centered) PLUS a layered box-shadow that pairs a CAST drop shadow with an INSET shadow on the opposite (lower) side for material curvature. Gold-standard sphere: background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#fef3c7,#fbbf24 70%,#d97706); box-shadow:0 0 60px rgba(251,191,36,.65), inset 0 -12px 20px rgba(180,83,9,.25). Recolor the three stops to brand hues for any orb/medallion/coin/disc. NEVER a flat single-color fill on a hero shape, stat tile, logo lockup, icon disc, or feature panel.

DEPTH IS MEASURED IN LAYERS, NOT PAINT. Every board carries at least 2-3 relating material layers (a base field that is itself a gradient or radial-vignette — never a flat fill; a textured/duotone/color-blocked supporting layer; focal content that sits on top with lift). Obey ONE light source top-left across the whole board. Pick the shadow grammar by mood: premium drop-alpha .20-.35 + a 1px inset top hairline highlight (inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.12)); playful drop-alpha up to .30; stack a soft+tight pair (0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.18), 0 16px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.14)) for a believable contact+ambient shadow.

DEPTH ON TEXT COMES FROM text-shadow / glow / gradient-fill — NEVER a backing box (this is how depth coexists with the no-redaction-bars law). Letterpress emboss on a light surface: text-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7); legibility lift over a photo/dark field WITHOUT a scrim box: text-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.45); hand-drawn double-pop (playful only): text-shadow:2px 2px 0 #fff. On a dark field a faint same-hue glow (text-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(accent,.35)) lifts an accent headline. Reach for a 0-blur or low-blur text-shadow FIRST; never a solid block behind glyphs.

THE WORDMARK / HERO HEADLINE IS ITSELF A DESIGNED OBJECT via background-clip:text — a brand-palette gradient PAINTED INTO the glyphs with ZERO background fill behind the box. Gold standard: background:linear-gradient(90deg,c1,c2,c3,c4); background-size:300% 100%; -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; color:transparent (+ -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent). Build the stops from the BRAND palette (rainbow only for playful/kids). Premium = a tight 2-stop gold-foil gradient (deep-gold -> pale-gold -> deep-gold) clipped into a serif wordmark for an engraved-metal effect, depth from the gradient + a text-shadow, no box.

PERVASIVE BUT TASTEFUL MOTION, transform/opacity ONLY, dialed to mood. A finished board has a quiet heartbeat (2-4 looping animations on DECORATION + well-margined objects); a dead-still board reads as a flat slide. Animate the OBJECT's character (a medallion breathes scale(1)->scale(1.025); a masked conic ray-halo spins; a badge bounces a few px; stars twinkle opacity; a ribbon's text scrolls inside overflow:hidden; a clipped-gradient headline drifts background-position). Match the gold-standard keyframes (breathe/spin/twinkle/float/bob/wiggle/gradientShift). Motion is SEASONING — the load-bearing layout is static-safe.

MOTION LIVES ON DECORATION FIRST. Default movement targets carry NO text: ray halos, glow spheres, sparkles/glints, conic rings, drifting fields, floating brand-initial watermarks, ticker ribbons. These move freely because the layout engine ignores text-free leaves — but they MUST be marked aria-hidden + pointer-events:none and carry NO data-field, so they can never trip collision detection or be edited. Text-bearing objects move only as a WHOLE rigid unit (the object and its child text translate/scale/rotate together) and only when they have clear empty margin around them.

MAP THE CRAFT TO THE BRAND MOOD — the SAME CSS primitives express opposite moods; only the FORM language, palette saturation, and motion energy change. A clip-path polygon is a kids STARBURST or a luxury FACETED GEM / CHEVRON SEAL; a radial-gradient sphere is a cartoon SUN or a brushed gold-foil DISC; box-shadow rings are a CLOUD or a deep material-elevation stack; a conic-gradient is spinning sun-rays or a slow 12s gold-sheen sweep; @keyframes is a bouncy bounceNum or a 12s near-imperceptible breathe. A law firm / steakhouse / luxury salon gets sculpted serif numerals on a gold-foil medallion, deep material shadows, hairline-rule dividers, and ONE slow breathe — NEVER balloons, NEVER Caveat, NEVER emoji. A school / fair / kids vertical gets the full playful rainbow treatment.

TYPE PAIRING WITH FORM CONTRAST, OBJECT-AWARE (extends the existing two-family rule). The DISPLAY face sits on its object: a number on a medallion uses the heavy display weight (800/900) with font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums and tight tracking; a handwritten/script accent face (Fredoka/Caveat-energy via the loaded list) is for captions on washi-tape/ribbon objects in PLAYFUL moods ONLY — premium gets a high-contrast serif numeral (Cormorant Garamond / Playfair Display / Fraunces) + a clean sans body, with a second-voice italic-serif tagline. Two voices (display + secondary, different face/color/role) is the cheapest signal of human design.

COMMITTED, SATURATED, ON-BRAND COLOR — kill the timid default near-black field. Derive the FIELD from the brand mood: deep jewel/charcoal gradient for premium, a saturated brand-color block for bold/sale, warm cream/parchment for cafe/worship, candy-bright multi-stop for playful. Commit to ONE accent applied as TEXT COLOR to every emphasized token (eyebrow tick, headline emphasis word/punctuation, dividers, all values) — that recurrence is the signature. Never an off-brand hue; never two saturated hues directly on each other (they vibrate across a room).

AUGMENTED SELF-CHECK BEFORE OUTPUT (run in addition to the existing redaction-bar scan): (1) every KEY element is a NAMED non-rectangular object, not a rounded-rect; (2) no rectangle/pill/rounded-rect sits behind a single word/value/price/eyebrow; (3) each object's text is a normal-flow CHILD inside it, never an absolutely-positioned sibling layered over a separate shape; (4) every object has depth (offset radial highlight + paired drop+inset shadow); (5) decoration layers carry no text and are aria-hidden + pointer-events:none with no data-field; (6) motion is transform/opacity only and moves no text leaf out of its safe area; (7) any mask/-webkit-mask donut ships BOTH forms on adjacent lines; (8) no gap on flex/grid; (9) the craft level matches the brand mood (no balloons/Caveat/emoji on a premium board, no flat boxes anywhere). Fix every failure before returning.
objectVsRedactionRule: You MAY seat ONE COMPLETE content group (a whole stat: number+unit+label; the whole time: digits+AM/PM; a whole offer: amount+terms) on ONE designed object — but ONLY when ALL FOUR hold: (a) the object has an intentional NON-RECTANGULAR silhouette built with clip-path:polygon, border-radius:50%, a multi-value organic border-radius blob, a fused box-shadow cloud/scallop, or an inline SVG shape (a plain rectangle, rounded-rect, or pill does NOT qualify); (b) the text it carries is its CHILD / descendant in normal flow (so the shape FRAMES the text, the VOS-FIT-ENGINE skips the ancestor↔descendant pair, and they ride and freeze as one unit); (c) it is a deliberate FOCAL compositional element that would still read as 'an object' with the text removed; and (d) the text ALREADY clears the contrast floor against the object's OWN fill, with contrast coming from the shape's depth (gradient field + inset/drop shadow + offset light-source highlight), NOT from a flat fill added to rescue an unreadable color. It is a BANNED redaction bar whenever ANY holds: it is a rectangle / rounded-rect / pill; it wraps an individual word, value, price, eyebrow, label, or headline-emphasis span inside otherwise-unboxed running text; it exists only because the text color failed on the field behind it; or it is white-behind-text used as a contrast crutch. THE TEST: remove the text — if a deliberate OBJECT with a silhouette you could point to remains, it is CRAFT (keep it shaped + gradiented); if only a colored box that existed solely to hold the word remains, it is a redaction bar — delete it and fix contrast up the ladder (recolor the text → deepen the field → for text over a busy photo, a full-bounding-box scrim under the ENTIRE text block). A 'stat card' that is just a rounded-rect is a redaction bar at GROUP scale — promote it to a real medallion/starburst or leave the stat on the open field with color+weight. The at-most-ONE-solid-fill-element law is unchanged: the only opaque rectangular fill on the whole board is AT MOST ONE CTA button.
perVerticalMoodMap: PLAYFUL — school / kids / fair / community / QSR / sale: display+secondary = Fredoka (or Poppins) / Mulish (a script-energy accent line allowed). Palette = candy-bright multi-stop gradients, saturated warm field. Shape motif = starburst badge + fused cloud + notched ribbon + balloon cluster (clip-path star, box-shadow cloud, multi-value border-radius balloons). Motion = LIVELY: 4-6 simultaneous loops, bounce/wiggle/shake/bob/twinkle, 1.4-4s, translate 10-14px, scale→1.06, rotate ±3-12deg, springy ease-in-out. Emoji + hard 2px 2px 0 #fff text-shadow OK.

PREMIUM — law firm / steakhouse / fine-dining / luxury salon / hotel / finance / fashion: display+secondary = Cormorant Garamond or Playfair Display (or Fraunces) / Nunito Sans, italic-serif tagline as second voice. Palette = deep jewel / charcoal field + ONE restrained metallic accent (gold-foil 2-3 stop gradient). Shape motif = inline-SVG engraved double-rule seal or laurel + a brushed-gold conic medallion + hairline two-tone rules. Depth = deep material box-shadow (0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.45)) + inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.12) hairline. Motion = MINIMAL: 1-2 loops, ONE slow 8-14s breathe or gold-foil shimmer, travel ≤4px, scale ≤1.015, NO rotation on content, ease-in-out. NO balloons, NO Caveat, NO emoji.

CORPORATE / TECH / AGENCY / SaaS: display+secondary = Fraunces or Source Serif 4 or Sora / Inter. Palette = brand-primary field (or subtle radial-vignette) + ONE confident accent, generous whitespace. Shape motif = ONE confident die-cut badge or an accent-ringed stat disc or an oversized translucent brand-initial watermark; a 2-stop brand-gradient clipped wordmark. Depth = crisp single drops (.12-.20), one accent glow on a hero stat, etched hairline grids. Motion = MIDDLE: 2-3 loops, a slow headline gradient drift + a gentle 6s float on a logo chip, travel ≤8px, scale ≤1.03, 4-8s. Confident, not flashy; decisively NOT balloons.

EDITORIAL — cafe / bakery / boutique: display+secondary = Fraunces / Inter. Palette = warm cream/parchment or a duotone hero, calm. Shape motif = ONE bold die-cut badge + a torn-paper / coffee-ring band; clipped-gradient or solid-accent wordmark. Depth = a duotone graded photo panel + a glass-tint floating card (rgba .90-.96, NO backdrop-blur on Taurus). Motion = CALM: 1-2 slow loops or none; a 12s headline sheen at most. Generous whitespace.

BOLD — gym / sports / bar: display+secondary = Anton or Oswald or Barlow Condensed / Archivo or Barlow. Palette = high-energy SATURATED brand-color FIELD (never timid navy), tight tracking. Shape motif = chevron/blade-slash clip-path + hex plate + an SVG shield/pennant; headline in pure white or a hot 2-stop accent gradient. Depth = strong drops, halftone/diagonal repeating-linear-gradient texture, a hot accent glow on the hero number/price, hard text-shadow for legibility. Motion = KINETIC but transform/opacity-only, snappy.

exemplarCssAdditions.why: The single highest-leverage objecthood move: a whole content group (label+number+unit) seated in a recognizable die-cut silhouette so the shape IS the framing — text needs NO backing box, satisfying the no-redaction law. data-fit only on the short number (never the label/unit). Recolor the 3 radial stops + clip-path verbatim from the gold-standard countdown; swap the polygon for a 6-sided gem on premium.

exemplarCssAdditions.name: 3D sphere / gold-foil medallion (offset top-left highlight = volume)
exemplarCssAdditions.why: Verbatim gold-standard sun sphere — the OFFSET highlight (circle at 35% 30%) reads as a 3D body, not a flat circle; the colored outer shadow is a glow, the lower inset is the grounded shade. The --foil variant turns the SAME primitive into a brushed-metal medallion for premium moods (objecthood mapped to mood). Taurus-83 safe: radial + conic + inset-keyword box-shadow all parse on 83.

exemplarCssAdditions.name: Spinning masked conic ray-halo / slow gold sheen (decoration, NO text — ships BOTH mask forms)
exemplarCssAdditions.why: Gold-standard sun-ray ring (lines 234-238). CRITICAL Taurus trap: the -webkit-mask AND mask MUST ship on adjacent lines or Chromium-83 fills the cutout solid and the ring becomes an opaque disc. Longhand top/right/bottom/left (NEVER inset:-50px). Carries no text + pointer-events:none so the layout engine ignores it. Premium swaps the sunburst for a single soft conic wedge at 24s for a slow metallic sheen.

exemplarCssAdditions.name: Fused cloud / scallop / soft focal blob (one element, no rectangle — content sits ON it)
exemplarCssAdditions.why: Gold-standard cloud puff (line 276): one circle whose box-shadow lists ~9 offset white circles, then a second pass 4-6px larger in --accent for the outline, then a final cast shadow. Makes an announcement headline sit ON a cloud (z-index:-1, text-shadow on the text for separation) instead of in a redaction rectangle. Premium reuse: a soft elevated neutral panel-blob as a non-rectangular focal backing.

exemplarCssAdditions.name: Gradient-clipped wordmark (painted into glyphs, zero box) + drifting sheen
exemplarCssAdditions.why: Gold-standard RainbowAnimatedTitle h1 (lines 174-180): richness from a gradient clipped INTO the glyphs, never a fill behind the box. Only background-position animates = GPU-cheap on Taurus-83. Premium variant = a tight gold-foil gradient for an engraved-metal effect (no animation or 16s drift). The data-fit + data-fit-min hooks still apply to the wordmark.

exemplarCssAdditions.name: Static-safe decorative motion keyframes (transform/opacity only, capped amplitude, freeze-compatible)
exemplarCssAdditions.why: Direct ports of the gold-standard keyframes, all transform/opacity (compositor-only on Chromium-83). Apply to OBJECT wrappers (badge/orb/star/ribbon/well-margined panel), NEVER to a lone body-text leaf. The 0%/100% rest state is composition-correct so a frozen thumbnail (freeze=1 injects *{animation:none} after 1400ms) looks finished at any frame. Scope names with a vos- prefix so multiple boards don't leak keyframes.

motionContract: TRANSFORM + OPACITY ONLY — plus background-position for a clipped-text headline sheen. NEVER animate width/height/top/left/margin/font-size/color/box-shadow-blur/filter — they relayout or repaint, jank the Taurus GPU, and can shift the rects the VOS-FIT-ENGINE measures.

MOTION IS DECORATIVE SEASONING; THE LOAD-BEARING LAYOUT IS STATIC. The static layout must already be collision-free with all motion at REST — the engine re-measures text-leaf rects after settle and the freeze pass snapshots a frame, so the composition must be correct at 0% with nothing in flight.

TEXT MOVES ONLY AS A WHOLE RIGID OBJECT, never per-word and never with horizontal travel toward a neighbor. Allowed text motion: (a) breathe/float on the WHOLE bounded card/panel/medallion that wraps the text AND has clear empty margin around it (the text rides as one block, never approaching a neighbor); (b) background-position drift on a background-clip:text headline (the box never moves); (c) opacity-only fade. BANNED: per-word translateX, a headline that slides/rotates toward an adjacent element, any text motion that could close a gap below ~12px.

DECORATION-ONLY LAYERS (ray halos, glow spheres, sparkles/glints, conic rings, drifting fields, brand-initial watermarks) carry NO text, get aria-hidden + pointer-events:none + NO data-field, and sit behind content (lower z-index / z-index:-1). Because they have zero text content the layout engine's text-leaf detector ignores them, so they can move freely and can never trip a false collision.

AMPLITUDE/SPEED/COUNT BY MOOD TIER: PLAYFUL = 4-6 loops, translate ≤10-14px, scale ≤1.06, rotate ±3-12deg, 1.4-4s, springy ease-in-out. CORPORATE/EDITORIAL = 2-3 loops, translate ≤8px, scale ≤1.03, 4-8s. PREMIUM = 1-2 loops, ONE slow 8-14s breathe or gold-foil shimmer, travel ≤4px, scale ≤1.015, NO rotation on content. When unsure, go calmer — under-animating reads as restraint, over-animating reads as a toy.

STAY INSIDE THE SAFE AREA: an element's PEAK transform must remain within its band and never push it under a photo panel, into the reserved footer, or off-canvas. Reserve clearance equal to the max travel (an element that floats -10px needs ≥10px headroom above it).

EVERY LOOP IS infinite + SEAMLESS: symmetric keyframes (0%/100% identical, peak at 50%) for breathe/float/twinkle, or a continuous to{transform:rotate(360deg)} for rings; ease-in-out for organic motion, linear ONLY for continuous rotation and ticker scroll. Stagger sibling decorations with animation-delay (0s/.3s/.6s/.9s) so they don't pulse in lockstep.

FREEZE-COMPATIBLE: design so ANY frame (especially 0% rest) is composition-correct — NEVER start a load-bearing element off-screen / at scale(0) / at opacity:0 relying on the animation to bring it in (the freeze=1 thumbnail injects *{animation:none!important} after 1400ms and would snapshot it missing/half-in). Entrance flourishes are allowed ONLY on non-load-bearing decoration.

CHEAP ON A TAURUS GPU: add will-change:transform (or will-change:opacity) to each animated node so Chromium-83 composites it; cap simultaneous animating elements (~≤6 playful, ≤2-3 premium); NO animated backdrop-filter, NO animated filter:blur on a large area (a STATIC blur is fine — only animate transform/opacity on the blurred node); glow via a STATIC box-shadow, animate scale/opacity not the blur radius.

SCOPE @keyframes WITH A BOARD-UNIQUE PREFIX (vos-spin, vos-breathe, vos-sheen, vos-twinkle) declared in the inline <style>; no external animation libs, no JS rAF loops for decoration (pure CSS keyframes are what the freeze pass cleanly overrides).
rankedRisks: HIGHEST — the model promotes a 'stat card' or feature to a ROUNDED-RECTANGLE with a fill and calls it 'objecthood', re-introducing redaction bars at group scale (the exact 'serial killer' look the operator banned as priority #1). MITIGATION: the object-vs-redaction four-part test + the augmented self-check explicitly disqualify rectangle/rounded-rect/pill as a silhouette and require the remove-the-text test; only clip-path/border-radius:50%/blob/cloud/SVG silhouettes count.

HIGH — a masked conic ray-halo ships `mask:` WITHOUT its `-webkit-mask:` twin, so Chromium-83 drops the cutout and the ring renders as a SOLID opaque disc covering content. MITIGATION: motion contract + exemplar both mandate both forms on adjacent lines; ADD a new warning to auditDesignerHtmlTaurus: flag any `mask:` declaration lacking a `-webkit-mask:` twin so masked donuts can't ship one-sided.

HIGH — the model builds an object as an absolutely-positioned TEXT leaf layered OVER a separate shape leaf (instead of nesting the text as the shape's child), which the VOS-FIT-ENGINE registers as a real collision and down-scales the type, or the board reads as broken. MITIGATION: the object-vs-redaction rule (clause b) + self-check #3 require text to be a normal-flow CHILD inside the object so the engine skips the ancestor↔descendant pair.

MEDIUM-HIGH — premium verticals get the playful kit anyway (balloons, Caveat/script, emoji, bouncy motion), making a law firm / steakhouse look cheap — the operator's named failure. MITIGATION: per-vertical mood map makes the craft constant but the FORM/motion mood-specific, with explicit NO-balloons/NO-Caveat/NO-emoji + ≤1.015 scale + 8-14s motion bands for premium.

MEDIUM — the model reaches for `gap` to space a multi-part object's children (the easiest thing to reach for when building a stat cluster), or the `inset` shorthand on a decorative absolute layer — both silently break on Taurus-83. MITIGATION: craft rules mandate per-child margin + longhand top/right/bottom/left; existing auditDesignerHtmlTaurus already flags both.

MEDIUM — over-animation: 6+ heavy loops or animating box-shadow-blur/filter:blur tanks the Taurus LED-wall frame rate. MITIGATION: motion contract caps simultaneous animations by mood, forbids animating blur/filter/box-shadow-blur, and requires will-change on each animated node.

MEDIUM — a load-bearing element starts at opacity:0/scale(0)/off-screen as an entrance flourish and the freeze=1 thumbnail snapshots it missing or half-in (gallery previews look broken). MITIGATION: motion contract's freeze-compatibility rule forbids entrance animation on load-bearing content; only decoration may animate in.

LOWER — decorative objects carry a data-field and become accidentally editable / clickable, or trip collision detection. MITIGATION: contract requires decoration to be aria-hidden + pointer-events:none with NO data-field.
LOWER — keyframe name collisions between sibling boards mounted together leak animations. MITIGATION: vos- (or board-unique) keyframe-name prefix mandated in the contract.

LOWER — depth-via-glow reached for with filter:blur/backdrop-filter (flaky on Android WebView 83). MITIGATION: contract + exemplars use a large soft same-hue box-shadow for glow instead, and animate scale/opacity not the blur radius.
